release_notes: A conversion can no longer be lost to a slow click: a postback that arrives while its click is still in the spool (the database was locked when the click came in) is parked as Waiting for click, answered 200, and replayed by the cron once the click lands - stamped with the time the postback was received, never rolling back a newer status, and closed as No click found after two hours; with an idle spool an unknown subid is still an honest 404. The Orbitra databases (geo, mobile operators, bots) install from the project's site with one click or by file upload: the geo base takes priority for country/region/city/ISP, the bot list is a blocklist hit in the bot filter and the cloak. A new Mobile operator stream filter and the now-working Connection type store the operator and the connection type on every click - visible in click details, groupable in reports. The top bar keeps its full layout up to ~1650px windows.
